title: Will heavy rain disrupt last-mile delivery operations in Warsaw on 2026-06-03?
background: Provisional live-data prototype question for the selected weather-logistics wedge.
resolutionCriteria: Resolve Yes if the declared operations source reports at least one weather-coded delivery disruption in Warsaw on 2026-06-03 and the declared weather observation source records daily precipitation of at least 20 millimeters. Resolve No otherwise.

validOutcomeSpace.description: Binary outcome: Yes if disruption and precipitation criteria are both satisfied; No otherwise.

incentiveRiskReview.notes: Prototype public-weather input with unresolved operations outcome.
